_comment: Module map of this repository (owner decision, 2026-11-20: four modules incl. Internal, which replaced Kit and tools; owner decision, 2026-11-24: Task Queue is a fifth, top-level module; owner decision, 2026-11-25 (PC-116): DevOps is a sixth, top-level module (replacing internal/devops) with only the sub-modules the owner named; tests are not a module, each test file follows the code it tests). Same shape as the modules file the cockpit reads (--modules): modules[{id,name,desc}], assign[{path,module,basis?,candidates?,alias?}]. Longest matching path prefix wins (a path ending in '/' is a prefix, otherwise an exact file). module=null is an explicit 'unassigned'; 'candidates' (optional, decision data) lists the modules a file could equally belong to and changes no assignment; 'alias' marks a pseudo-path that is not a tracked file. Test files follow the mirrored source path (tests/tools/test_x.py -> tools/x.py), then an entry for the test path itself. A file that cannot be placed in a sub-module goes to the parent; a file ambiguous between modules stays null and is reported. Guard: tests/tools/test_cardmeta_map.py.

modules.name: GitHub client
modules.desc: the Cockpit app as a client of GitHub: logic.py (pure rules, parsing, ranking, card views, settings and token-usage views) and cockpit.py (HTTP server, gh calls, caching, actions)

modules.name: Documentation
modules.desc: docs/ and the root README and LICENSE: constitution, ADRs, memos, research notes, contracts, deployment, screenshots and owner defaults; documents whose Modules line names one other module are listed with that module

modules.name: Internal
modules.desc: what keeps the project and its assistants running, as opposed to the product (template default for every project); itself it holds tools/shots.py, the screenshot tool

modules.name: Task Queue
modules.desc: the Dispatcher and the Workers that work the task queue, with their specification (docs/specs/dispatcher-and-workers.md) and the documents that name it

modules.name: DevOps
modules.desc: what installs, runs, protects and delivers the Cockpit and its projects: the kit/ issue forms and helpers for a consuming repository, repository configuration (.gitignore), the deployment document, service management, delivery to projects and the hosting-service kit; the parts below are its sub-modules

modules.name: Dispatcher
modules.desc: the host-side procedure that assigns released tasks to Workers and collects their results: firing logic, task source, container runtime and agent adapter, host probes, the proxy, the quota collector, the processing log and the LaunchAgent renderer

modules.name: Worker
modules.desc: what runs inside the Workers' container: the image (Containerfile), its Stop hook and note skill, and the relay to the host proxy

modules.name: E2E test
modules.desc: end-to-end tests of the task queue: the failure-path test driver (tools/e2e_failure_paths.py) and the stub of the model with its derived image (tools/e2e/), with their tests

modules.name: Project metadata
modules.desc: this module map, the footprint declaration and the card-metadata collectors (tools/cardmeta_*.py) with their tests

modules.name: Agent policies and skills
modules.desc: standing instructions for assistants (CLAUDE.md), skill and agent definitions (.claude/) and the brief check the agent-brief skill runs (tools/check_brief.py)

modules.name: Installation
modules.desc: installing the Cockpit in a repository: kit/setup.sh and the test of the README install commands (the installer of PC-100 joins it when it lands)

modules.name: Backup
modules.desc: the daily backup of a project's Cockpit data to Drive (tools/project_backup.py), its Drive retention script, the restore test (tools/backup_restore.py) and the backup contract

modules.name: CI
modules.desc: continuous integration: the GitHub Actions test workflow (the local gate and the merge gate of PC-94 join it when built)

modules.name: Monitoring and alerts
modules.desc: heartbeat pings to the monitoring service and desktop notifications for a missing heartbeat or a failed or stale backup (PC-142): ckp/core/monitor.py, ckp/adapters/notify.py, `ckp heartbeat` and `ckp watch`

modules.name: Policy and compliance
modules.desc: checks and enforcement of standing policies: the policy-finding tool (tools/file_finding.py) and the protected-label check of the kit and the policy harness of PC-91 (tools/policy_harness.py) (the compliance check and Policies tab of PC-108, PC-109 join it)

modules.name: Deployment and environments
modules.desc: development, test and production environments: the environment-isolation design, the scripted test environment (tools/test_env.py) and its test; the deploy command and the release store live in the ckp package (PC-84); the Environments view's records and its deploy button, ckp/core/environments.py (PC-142)
